coverage: Tang Chang'an–Luoyang pilot. Intervals describe this layer's coverage, not the entire lifetime of a site. Coordinates locate surviving sites or archaeological areas approximately; no reconstructed footprints are implied.
coordinateSource: Wikidata P625, CC0, retrieved 2026-11-02. Descriptions are original summaries of linked historical sources.

sites.title: 太极宫
sites.detail: 隋代宫城，唐初继续使用。此点表示宫城遗址的大致位置。
sites.detailEn: A Sui palace complex used by the early Tang court. The marker identifies the approximate archaeological area.

sites.title: 大明宫
sites.detail: 始建于634年，后成为唐代重要宫廷与政务中心，896年毁于战火。
sites.detailEn: Construction began in 634. The palace became a Tang court and government center and was destroyed in 896.

sites.title: 大雁塔
sites.detail: 652年由玄奘主持兴建，用于保存从印度带回的经卷。现存建筑经历后世修缮。
sites.detailEn: Built in 652 under Xuanzang to house scriptures brought from India. The surviving structure includes later alterations.

sites.title: 小雁塔
sites.detail: 荐福寺塔，始建于707年，是唐代长安佛教建筑的重要遗存。
sites.detailEn: The Jianfu Temple pagoda was begun in 707 and survives as a major monument of Tang Chang'an.

sites.title: 白马寺
sites.detail: 始建于东汉68年的佛寺。此图层标示其唐代时期的位置，非现存建筑的年代。
sites.detailEn: Founded in 68 during the Eastern Han. This layer marks the Tang-era site, rather than dating today's buildings to the Tang.

sites.title: 龙门石窟
sites.detail: 伊河两岸的石窟群，北魏至唐代持续营造，唐代造像是其中的重要部分。
sites.detailEn: Caves along the Yi River were carved from the Northern Wei through the Tang, including major Tang Buddhist sculptures.
